newsitem.title: USA: R.R. Donnelley unit takes MedAccess stake.
newsitem.headline: R.R. Donnelley unit takes MedAccess stake.

text.p: R.R. Donnelley Financial, a communications process manager in managed healthcare, said it made an investment in MedAccess Corp, a provider of healthcare and health information on the Internet.
The dollar amount was not disclosed.

Terms call for Donnelley Financial to provide direct marketing support for MedAccess' Internet-based service called Health Fair On-line, the first interactive employee benefits enrollment and wellness management system on the World Wide Web.
Donnelley Financial is a subsidiary of R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, a supplier of print and digital information for the publishing, retailing, merchandising and information technology markets.
